steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: apply-draft
steps.eval: window.__aiResult = window.__applyAiVisionResponse(JSON.stringify({ walls: [ { x1: 0, z1: 0, x2: 6, z2: 0 }, { x1: 6, z1: 0, x2: 6, z2: 4 }, { x1: 6, z1: 4, x2: 0, z2: 4 }, { x1: 0, z1: 4, x2: 0, z2: 0 } ], openings: [ { kind: 'door', x: 3, z: 0, width: 0.9 }, { kind: 'window', x: 6, z: 2, width: 1.4 } ], scale: { metresPerPixel: 0.02 } }))

steps.name: probe
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const viaWalls = s.floorPlan.walls.flatMap(w => (w.openings || []).map(o => w.id + ':' + (o.kind || o.type))); return JSON.stringify({ walls: s.floorPlan.walls.length, viaWalls, topLevel: (s.floorPlan.openings || []).length }); })()
